title: Alekson Garn's trial
summary: Clear Alekson Garn’s three guarded rooms while protecting the maidens of Marr.
overview: Clear Alekson Garn’s three guarded rooms while protecting the maidens of Marr.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Speak with Alekson to enter the trial, then defeat its Custodian of Marr to start the room encounters.
Each room begins with five enemies. Clear the room to bring out its named opponent: Advocent Joran, Halgoz Rell or Freegan Haun.
Protect the maidens throughout the trial. Their loss can fail the event even if the attackers are being defeated.
Defeat all three named opponents, then return to Alekson’s projection for trial credit.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
